title: One base, one disease: the sickle-cell codon
intro: This is the coding sequence of the human β-globin gene (HBB), counted from the A of the start codon ATG (c.1). Choose a position and a new base: the engine names the change as a geneticist writes it (HGVS), translates both proteins and says what the change does. Find the single substitution that turns the glutamic acid of codon 7 into a valine.
sitesLabel: Bsu36I sites left (2 in the normal gene)
namesTitle: The change at the DNA level (c.) and at the protein level (p.)
protTitle: The normal protein (top) and the changed one (bottom) around the change
